title: When Dynamic Scaling Fails: A Scale-State Feedback Governs Recurrent-State Quantization in Linear-Attention and SSM LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.15139v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Linear-attention and state-space LLMs carry long context in a fixed-size recurrent state, and quantizing that state is the natural way to cut its cost during long decode. Unlike a weight tensor, the state is rewritten at every step, so a quantizer applied at each step sits inside the recurrence and its errors compound. INT4 that leaves synthetic recall perfectly intact at the start destroys it a thousand steps later. The mechanism is a feedback between the quantizer scale and the state it is derived from. Yoking that scale to a full-precision reference removes the resulting norm explosion entirely, yet recovers only 1.8 of the 5.4 nats lost, so numerical instability and functional degradation are separable failures. The remainder is resolution-dependent, and in our per-step setting every outlier-aware scheme we test loses to plain persistent scaling. translated_title: 当动态缩放失效时：尺度-状态反馈主导线性注意力与状态空间大语言模型中的循环状态量化
translated_abstract: 线性注意力和状态空间大语言模型将长上下文存储在固定大小的循环状态中，对该状态进行量化是长解码过程中降低其成本的天然途径。与权重张量不同，状态在每一步都会被重写，因此在每一步施加的量化器位于递推循环内部，其误差会不断累积。初始阶段对合成记忆任务完全无损的INT4量化，在一千步之后会将其彻底破坏。其机制在于量化器尺度与其所来源状态之间的反馈。将该尺度绑定到全精度参考值上可以完全消除由此产生的范数爆炸，但仅能挽回5.4 nats损失中的1.8，因此数值不稳定与功能退化是可分离的两种失效。剩余的损失与分辨率相关，在每步量化设置中，所测试的所有离群值感知方案均不敌简单的持久缩放。跨层分配比特位确实有帮助，但在article-disjoint划分下，学习到的策略……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了线性注意力与状态空间大语言模型中循环状态量化的失效根源——量化器尺度与状态之间的反馈回路使误差在递推中累积并引发范数爆炸，并证明数值不稳定与功能退化是可分离的两种失效，其中前者可通过全精度参考缩放完全消除。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies a scale-state feedback as the mechanism governing recurrent-state quantization failures in linear-attention and SSM LLMs, showing that numerical instability and functional degradation are separable failures—the former fully eliminated by anchoring the quantizer scale to a full-precision reference.
